title: Introducing Auto-transfer
summary: Hi there, Auto-transfer feature access is rolling out Auto-transfer splits the money coming into your Truss account across your other Truss accounts,…
body_markdown:
Hi there,


**Auto-transfer feature access is rolling out**


Auto-transfer splits the money coming into your Truss account across your other Truss accounts, automatically. Set a rule once, and Truss sends a set percentage of every payment to the accounts you choose.


**Manual money movement no more**


Forget manually moving money between your account, now you can split each payment as it lands by sending a percentage of each payment to up to 10 of your Truss accounts. You can also choose what splits, all incoming money, or just invoice payments paid through Truss.


**Setting the rules**


Easily set auto-transfer rules to move money automatically across your Truss accounts.


[Set It Up →](https://try.trusspayments.com/help/article/auto-transfer-rules)
